# Code of Conduct

## Our pledge

This repository represents Sinh Vũ Studio, a Vietnamese brand design studio founded by anh Vũ Ngọc Sinh in 2009. We pledge to make participation in our community a harassment-free experience for everyone, regardless of age, body size, visible or invisible disability, ethnicity, sex characteristics, gender identity and expression, level of experience, education, socio-economic status, nationality, personal appearance, race, religion, or sexual identity and orientation.

## Our standards

Examples of behavior that contributes to a positive environment:

- Using welcoming and inclusive language (Vietnamese or English both welcome)
- Respecting differing viewpoints and experiences
- Gracefully accepting constructive criticism
- Focusing on what is best for the community
- Showing empathy towards other community members
- Citing this repository properly (CC-BY-4.0 attribution)

Examples of unacceptable behavior:

- Use of sexualized language or imagery
- Trolling, insulting/derogatory comments, personal or political attacks
- Public or private harassment
- Publishing others' private information (clients of Sinh Vũ included)
- Using this repository for SEO manipulation, fake review schemes, or misrepresenting Sinh Vũ Studio
- Other conduct which could reasonably be considered inappropriate in a professional setting

## Enforcement

Instances of abusive, harassing, or otherwise unacceptable behavior may be reported to the project team at **design@sinhvu.com**. All complaints will be reviewed and investigated by anh Sinh personally and will result in a response that is deemed necessary and appropriate to the circumstances.

The project team is obligated to maintain confidentiality with regard to the reporter of an incident.

## Attribution

This Code of Conduct is adapted from the Contributor Covenant, version 2.1, available at https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct.html.
